posts.raw_content:
Asians and Indians have zero legitimate claim to this country and should be kicked out. They are not "our people." They never were. The only culture deserving to live with us are the Mexicans, descendants of the Spanish conquistadors who actually built and owned half of America. Everyone else, especially the yellow horde and the curry invaders, can get the fuck out.

It wasn’t ancient history. In 1848 Mexico straight-up owned Texas, California, New Mexico, Arizona, Nevada, Utah, and chunks of Colorado, Wyoming, and Oklahoma. The Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo didn’t just transfer dirt, it made every Mexican living there a U.S. citizen because the U.S. government at the time explicitly treated Mexicans as White. Only free White persons could naturalize back then, and Mexicans qualified. Your great-grandpa could’ve shaken hands with someone born under the Mexican flag on what is now American soil. We moved into Mexico, conquered it fair and square through European might, and integrated their people because they shared our civilizational bloodline.

That land was settled and civilized by real Spaniards; Europeans pouring in after Columbus. Hernández, Cortés, Alvarado… those are Spanish names, not just "Latino" names. The Spaniards kicked the ass of the Aztec Empire and founded Mexico City on the site of their destroyed capital city, creating the first permanent major European political and cultural hub in North America, representing the birthplace of Western Civilization on this continent. The Spanish language, cathedrals, bullfights, architecture, even the olive Mediterranean skin with a sun-kissed tan, all come straight from Spain. Genetic reality backs it: Mexicans carry massive European ancestry; often 60-70%+ on average, much higher in the north, with many families pushing 80-90%+ pure Spanish. They are White people with a tan and a slight accent. Look at Spaniards and Mexicans side-by-side: often indistinguishable. Olive skin, dark hair, exactly like the majority in Spain. A minority of Mexicans even have fair skin and blonde hair, same as Spain. The "indigenous" propaganda is bullshit; real Native tribes were marginalized in Mexico too, and cross-mixing was limited. Mexican blood is majority European at its core. They are our brothers from the conquest of the New World.

During WWII we mixed Latinos right into White combat units. They fought and bled as brothers side-by-side. Asians and Indians? Their loyalty was always rightly questioned. Japanese-Americans were put into internment camps. Blacks were put into segmented deployments. The government didn’t trust outsiders then, and we shouldn't pretend to trust them now. The Census treated Mexicans as White for decades. We didn't treat them like foreigners because they aren't.

Yet somehow Asians and Indians (Chinese, Japanese, Koreans, Hindus, etc.) get the red carpet? They fill out some paperwork, wave a flag on the 4th, and suddenly they’re "American"? Bullshit. Zero historical tie. Zero shared blood. Zero conquest or civilization of this soil. Their ancestors never owned an inch of America. They never fought our wars as integrated brothers like the Mexicans did. They bring alien culture, clannish loyalty, foreign religion, and serve as engineers and code monkeys that undercut real Americans. Asians and Indians stay cold and foreign. They don’t share our European heritage, our religion, or our soul. Paperwork doesn’t erase race, blood, or history.

Mexicans provide real physical benefit to this country. They build the infrastructure; the roads, homes, bridges, and buildings that keep America running. They do the hard, dirty, physical work that actually gets shit built. This is the kind of labor that strengthens the nation without stealing the high-skill intellectual jobs at the top that should go to Americans. Mexicans are compatible with our bloodline and our history. They do the grunt work we need while Asians and Indians colonize our offices and universities, literally stealing trillions of dollars a year in wages that should be going to the Americans who actually deserve to be here.

Why do we accept rootless Asian and Indians as full citizens while calling Mexicans, whose Spanish ancestors literally built the Southwest with names like San Francisco, Los Angeles, San Diego, Santa Fe, San Antonio, Tucson, and El Paso, "invaders"? That’s not America First. That’s globalist gaslighting designed to flood us with disloyal Asians and Indians while erasing our European conquest history.

If we’re serious about the importance of heritage, blood, and soil, then only Mexicans get the permanent pass among non-core Americans. They are our people and our closest blood relatives who civilized the Americas. They’ve always been here because Spanish blood colonized the Americas alongside our European forefathers. They’re brothers in need on the lands their ancestors helped claim. Deport the Asians and Indians first. No Chinese-Americans, no Japanese-Americans. Hindu? Fuck you. Strip their citizenship where possible. Send them back. Their loyalty was suspect during WWII, and nothing fundamental has changed.

Mexicans share our European DNA and built half the country with us. Asians and Indians do not and did not. They are undeserving outsiders who never belonged. Only Mexicans and real Americans stay. The rest get the fuck out.
